install.title: Install the app
install.link: Put the app on your home screen
install.intro: Put Fumble & Glory on your home screen or desktop. It opens like an app, without the browser bar, and also works offline.
install.installed: You're already using the installed app.
install.ios.title: iPhone & iPad
install.ios.2: Tap the Share button (the square with the arrow pointing up).
install.ios.3: Scroll down, choose “Add to Home Screen” and tap “Add”.
install.android.title: Android
install.android.2: Tap the menu ⋮ in the top right corner.
install.android.3: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen” and confirm.
install.desktop.title: Computer (Chrome, Edge)
install.desktop.1: Click the install icon at the right end of the address bar.
install.desktop.2: If there is none, open the browser menu and choose “Install Fumble & Glory” (in Edge: Apps › Install this site as an app).
install.desktop.3: You'll then find the app in the start menu or Applications folder and can pin it to the taskbar or Dock.
install.desktop.firefox: Firefox can't install web apps. Use Chrome or Edge instead, or simply bookmark the page.
install.mac.title: Mac (Safari)
install.mac.1: In the menu bar, choose File › Add to Dock.
install.mac.2: Click “Add”. The app appears in the Dock and in Launchpad.
install.offline: Once installed, the cards work without internet. New cards load automatically the next time you're online.
deck.customHint: You can create your own cards in the installed app.

help.title: How it works
help.intro: Fumble & Glory turns every natural 1 and natural 20 into a small story. Instead of a plain miss or double damage, you draw a card with an effect.
help.fumble.title: Fumble: natural 1
help.fumble.text: If your d20 shows a 1 on an attack roll, the attack misses and something goes wrong. Draw a fumble.
help.glory.title: Glory: natural 20
help.glory.text: If it shows a 20, you score a critical hit as usual and get something extra on top. Draw a glory.
help.setup.title: Before you play
help.setup.text: In the table settings, enter your character and pick a class group: melee, ranged or magic. You only draw cards that fit your class.
help.tones.title: Tones
help.tones.text: Tones decide what kind of cards are in the deck: from awkward to painful for fumbles, from heroic to brutal for glories. Agree on them as a group, so nobody draws a card the table doesn't want.
help.severity.title: Severity
help.severity.text: Severity limits how strong the effects get: mild for light consequences, harsh for when it should really hurt or shine.
help.gm.title: The GM has the final say
help.gm.text: Read the card out loud. If an effect doesn't fit the situation, the GM can adjust it or have you draw again.
